up: Retrieve all activity records for the assay with ChEMBL identifier 'CHEMBL1614236'. For each activity record, provide the compound's ChEMBL identifier (molecule_chembl_id), preferred name (pref_name), canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles), standard type (standard_type), standard relation (standard_relation), standard value (standard_value), standard units (standard_units), pchembl value (pchembl_value), and BAO endpoint (bao_endpoint). Include all rows without filtering on relation, units, or any other fields. Do not limit the number of rows returned.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.pchembl_value, a.bao_endpoint FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614236'
